claims.text: Drink of barley and water; Hymn to Demeter version with pennyroyal; used at the climax of the Eleusinian Mysteries to break a sacred fast; ergot hypothesis; Burkert rejected ergot, fasting plus sacrificial meal could produce 'communal bliss'; Mas Castellar de Pontós (Girona) chapel with Eleusinian kraters, ergot traces in a chalice linked to kykeon

entries.topic: Penguin Random House, The Road to Eleusis (Wasson, Hofmann, Ruck)

claims.text: First released 1978; proposes the sacred potion of the Eleusinian rites was 'infused with a potent, psychoactive entheogen'

sources.label: Penguin Random House, The Road to Eleusis (Wasson, Hofmann, Ruck)

entries.topic: Encyclopedia of the Great Plains, "Native American Church"

claims.text: Services in a tipi; Roadman leads, Fireman keeps the sacred fire; sundown to sunrise; peyote a controlled drug, members may use it religiously; AIRFA 1978; Smith 1990; amendments 1994 and 1996

sources.label: Encyclopedia of the Great Plains, "Native American Church"

entries.topic: Free Speech Center (MTSU), "American Indian Religious Freedom Act of 1978, as amended in 1994"

claims.text: AIRFA policy 'to protect and preserve for American Indians their inherent right of freedom to believe, express, and exercise' traditional religions; Employment Division v. Smith (1990): state need not exempt sacramental peyote from general drug laws; 1994 amendment: 'the use, possession, or transportation of peyote by an Indian for bona fide traditional ceremonial purposes' lawful

sources.label: Free Speech Center (MTSU), "American Indian Religious Freedom Act of 1978, as amended in 1994"
